SECTION 4: FOOD SECURITY: Climate change influence many aspects of life including nutrition and food. In this regard, I would like to ask few questions about food. During the last one year, was there a time when:
Q401. During the last one year, was there a time when you or others in your household were worried about not having enough food to eat because of lack of money or other resources?

Q402. Still thinking about the last 1 year, was there a time when you or others in your household were unable to eat healthy and nutritious food because of lack of money or other resources? (Explain the nutritious food, region wise/state specific)

Q403. Was there a time when you or others in your household ate only a few kinds of foods because of lack of money or other resources? Details can be provided as examples of some food items which are region/state specific.

Q405. Still thinking about the last one year, was there a time when you or others in your household ate less than you thought you should because of lack of money or other resources?

Q409. Was there a time when you or others in your household went without eating for a whole day because of lack of money or other resources?

Q410. In the last 1 year, how often did it happen that you or others in your household went without eating for a whole day because of lack of money or other resources? Did this happen only once or twice, in some months but not every month, or almost every month?
